summary: Meta's 10-day virtual Global AI Developer Hackathon gives every participant $150 of Meta Model API credits, with a $1M cash prize pool. Applications are not open yet; Meta's page offers a sign-up to be notified when they open.
claim_steps: Open the hackathon page at dev.meta.ai/events/global-hackathon.
Sign up with your name and email to get notified when applications open.
Apply once applications open; participants receive $150 of Meta Model API credits.

social_proof.title: Win $1M: Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon
social_proof.text: Apply for a 10-day global virtual hackathon from Meta Superintelligence Labs. Build on the newest models from Meta through Meta Model API. Every participant gets $150 of Meta Model API credits. $1M cash prize pool. Virtual, worldwide. Applications opening soon.

social_proof.title: Meta Connect 2026: The end-to-end recap
social_proof.text: Build on Meta Model API, Muse Code or our open-weights models, with free Model API credits. There are two tracks, one for indie developers and one for startup teams, and a $1M cash prize pool. Sign up to get notified when applications open at dev.meta.ai.
